gloss: a long passage of text; a long message

definitions.gloss: a long passage of text; a long piece of writing
definitions.explanation: Writing that is long relative to what the situation calls for: a reading-comprehension passage on an exam, or a message far longer than a normal one. Often carries a mild sense that the length is a burden on the reader.

examples.japanese: {長文|ちょうぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長文|ちょうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The exam requires the ability to read long passages.

examples.japanese: {長文|ちょうぶん}になってしまい⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧お⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦いただければ→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です。
examples.english: I'm sorry this has become so long, but I would be grateful if you would read to the end.

notes:
Formed from {長|ちょう} (long) + ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (text, sentence). Two settings dominate: exam and study material ({長文読解|ちょうぶんどっかい}, long-passage comprehension), and messaging, where apologizing for a {長文|ちょうぶん} is a set courtesy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長文|ちょうぶん}⟦{読解|どっかい}→読解：15056_dokkai⟧: long-passage reading comprehension
- {長文|ちょうぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: a long email
- {長文|ちょうぶん}⟦{失礼|しつれい}しました→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧: sorry for the long message
- {長文|ちょうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要約|ようやく}→要約：14128_youyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to summarize a long text

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{短文|たんぶん}→短文：15812_tanbun⟧: a short passage — the direct antonym, also common in study materials
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: a piece of writing — neutral about length
